name: report_write
unavailable: This is not a scheduled run: report_write files the report of a schedule's run, and nobody scheduled this turn. Answer the person here instead.
description:
File this run's report for the person who set the schedule. They read it later, in their list of reports, and are notified of it — so write it to be read cold, by someone who does not see this conversation.

- Call it when your instructions for this run say a report is wanted, once, when the work is done.
- title: what it is about, as a headline. summary: one or two sentences for the list and the notification. body: the report itself, in Markdown — what you found, what you did, what needs their decision.
- importance: high only when they should look now.
- A run files one report: calling it again replaces the first.
- After it, end your reply with one short line for the run's history. Do not repeat the report.

title.description: A headline: what the report is about.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what a person needs to know before opening it.

importance.description: high: they should look now. Default normal.
